hardware: RTX 4090, driver 615.71.10, CUDA toolkit 13.3.73, Nsight Systems 2026.3.2.476
scope: Unchanged default-off candidate vs per-member control through the real AR Engine. Three paired fresh-process repetitions per burst width and mixed trace. No execution warmup. Load/compile excluded. Six separate profiles are not throughput samples. Source unchanged; no promotion.

burst.host_timing_scope: Total routing/enqueue/event-recording wall time over prefill plus 31 decode submissions; includes eager descriptor publication wait. Not decode-only, CPU-only or device time.

profiles.scope: One separate off/on profile per width, scalar prefill separated from 31 decode steps by ordered embedding kernels. Counts also reconcile to total kernel events. Profile durations are not native throughput clocks; no occupancy/stall inference.

source_derived_payloads.scope: Requested burst payloads only, not measured live allocations, backing, allocator overhead or physical peaks. 64 language layers, 24 query heads, 37-token reach rounded to 48. Scalar score scratch is 4608 bytes unchanged. All prepared decode lanes have packets; only selected burst lane has batched scores.

verification.scope_limit: New output comparison is token agreement, not new full-logit/state qualification. Existing separate parity/memcheck gates remain scoped evidence. No missing-device skips.

predeclared_decision.requires: At least 5% median paired throughput gain at BOTH c4/c8; c1 throughput regression <=3%; mixed throughput and TTFT/ITL p95 regressions <=3%; exact outputs and successful outcomes.
predeclared_decision.remaining_gates_if_revisited: Serving-owner reuse/disable, partial enqueue, failed drain; broader performance and endpoint qualification. No unchanged rerun without new evidence.
